### is&#95;match {#gaa2f0f4cff320a783ad2347c9ff3fc731}

<MemberDefinition
  prototype={<>bool micro&#95;os&#95;plus::micro&#95;test&#95;plus::utility::is&#95;match (std::string&#95;view input, std::string&#95;view pattern)</>}
  labels = {["nodiscard"]}>
Check if a string matches a pattern.

<ParametersList title="Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="[in] input">String view to check.</ParametersListItem>
<ParametersListItem name="[in] pattern">Sting view with the pattern.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>

<SectionUser title="Returns">
True if the string matches the pattern.
</SectionUser>

For tests comparing strings, in addition to exact matches, it is also possible to check matches with patterns like <code>&#42;</code> (for any characters) and <code>?</code> (for a single character)


<SectionUser title="Examples">

</SectionUser>


<ProgramListing extension="cpp">

<CodeLine><Highlight kind="keyword">namespace </Highlight><Highlight kind="normal">mt = <Link to="/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus">micro&#95;os&#95;plus::micro&#95;test&#95;plus</Link>;</Highlight></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><Highlight kind="normal"></Highlight></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><Highlight kind="normal">mt::expect (mt::utility::is&#95;match (</Highlight><Highlight kind="stringliteral">&quot;abc&quot;</Highlight><Highlight kind="normal">, </Highlight><Highlight kind="stringliteral">&quot;a?c&quot;</Highlight><Highlight kind="normal">)) &lt;&lt; </Highlight><Highlight kind="stringliteral">&quot;abc matches a?c&quot;</Highlight><Highlight kind="normal">;</Highlight></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><Highlight kind="normal">mt::expect (mt::utility::is&#95;match (</Highlight><Highlight kind="stringliteral">&quot;abc&quot;</Highlight><Highlight kind="normal">, </Highlight><Highlight kind="stringliteral">&quot;a&#42;c&quot;</Highlight><Highlight kind="normal">)) &lt;&lt; </Highlight><Highlight kind="stringliteral">&quot;abc matches a&#42;c&quot;</Highlight><Highlight kind="normal">;</Highlight></CodeLine>

</ProgramListing>

### split {#ga1b860aa64be17658d1664de447e6e125}

<MemberDefinition
  template={<>template &lt;class T = std::string&#95;view, class Delim&#95;T&gt;</>}
  prototype={<>std::vector&lt; T &gt; micro&#95;os&#95;plus::micro&#95;test&#95;plus::utility::split (T input, Delim&#95;T delim)</>}
  labels = {["nodiscard"]}>
Split a string into a vector of sub-strings.

For tests handling strings, this function template allows to split a string into a vector of substrings, using a delimiter.


<SectionUser title="Example">

</SectionUser>


<ProgramListing extension="cpp">

<CodeLine><Highlight kind="keyword">namespace </Highlight><Highlight kind="normal">mt = <Link to="/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus">micro&#95;os&#95;plus::micro&#95;test&#95;plus</Link>;</Highlight></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><Highlight kind="normal"></Highlight></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><Highlight kind="normal">mt::expect (std::vector&lt;std::string&#95;view&gt;&#123; </Highlight><Highlight kind="stringliteral">&quot;a&quot;</Highlight><Highlight kind="normal">, </Highlight><Highlight kind="stringliteral">&quot;b&quot;</Highlight><Highlight kind="normal"> &#125;</Highlight></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><Highlight kind="normal">            == mt::utility::split&lt;std::string&#95;view&gt; (</Highlight><Highlight kind="stringliteral">&quot;a.b&quot;</Highlight><Highlight kind="normal">, </Highlight><Highlight kind="stringliteral">&quot;.&quot;</Highlight><Highlight kind="normal">))</Highlight></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><Highlight kind="normal">        &lt;&lt; </Highlight><Highlight kind="stringliteral">&quot;a.b splits into [a,b]&quot;</Highlight><Highlight kind="normal">;</Highlight></CodeLine>

</ProgramListing>


<ParametersList title="Template Parameters">

<ParametersListItem name="Delim&#95;T">Type of the delimiter.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>

<ParametersList title="Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="[in] input">Input string to split.</ParametersListItem>
<ParametersListItem name="[in] delim">Delimiter string.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>

<SectionUser title="Returns">
An array of strings.
